statement: Alchemy model: items are subsets of b base items, combining is union; the number of distinct items reachable within depth d saturates at 2^b - 1. Exact for b=3 ([3,6,7,7]) and b=4 ([4,10,15,15,15]). A model of combination, not the comic's recipe.
alchemy.ath: the b = 3 alchemy circuit computes all seven nonempty unions on all 8 inputs, with 4 gates against a base of 5 (sharing, possible because the sets overlap in 2 points).

Toy 7-world branching history (reflexive, transitive): []c holds exactly on the alpha branch {1,4}, ~<>[]c exactly on the doomed branches {2,3,5,6}, and the branch point is the only world where <>[]c & ~[]c holds. A model chosen to illustrate the reading, not data from the comic. Independently recomputed by the reviewer.
